// Generated by Love Radar's native generator; edit the repo template instead.
package __PACKAGE__;

import android.Manifest;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.os.Build;
import com.getcapacitor.Plugin;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginCall;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginMethod;
import com.getcapacitor.annotation.CapacitorPlugin;

@CapacitorPlugin(name = "NativeCall")
public class NativeCallPlugin extends Plugin {
    @PluginMethod
    public void beginCall(PluginCall call) {
        String id = call.getString("id");
        String token = call.getString("token");
        if (id == null || !id.matches("[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}") ||
            token == null || !token.matches("[a-f0-9]{64}")) {
            call.reject("Session d'appel invalide.");
            return;
        }
        // Android 14+ requires a foreground activity when starting microphone FGS.
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.M &&
            getContext().checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO)
                 != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
            call.reject("Autorise le microphone avant de commencer l'appel.");
            return;
        }
        try {
            Intent service = new Intent(getContext(), NativeCallService.class);
            service.putExtra("id", id);
            service.putExtra("token", token);
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
                getContext().startForegroundService(service);
            } else {
                getContext().startService(service);
            }
            call.resolve();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            call.reject("Impossible de démarrer le service audio de cet appel.", null, e);
        }
    }

    @PluginMethod
    public void endCall(PluginCall call) {
        try {
            getContext().stopService(new Intent(getContext(), NativeCallService.class));
            call.resolve();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            call.reject("Impossible d'arrêter le service audio.", null, e);
        }
    }
}
